content: Our model outperforms all the sequence tagging models. T-BRNN-pre (row (c)) is the current state-of-the-art model, as shown in Table TABREF47 . The CVT model improves the overall F1 score from the 64.4% of T-BRNN-pre to 65.3% (row (h)), despite the fact that T-BRNN-pre integrates a pretrained word vector. Moreover, our model also achieves a 2-class F1 score 1.3% higher than that of Bi-LSTM-CRF (row (e)).
